caption: The video captures a pink-coated ice cream bar on a wooden stick embossed with a Hello Kitty logo, lying flat on a white plate. The bar has already lost its solid form, spreading into a flattened glossy pink mass whose shell is split by several cracks that expose a soft white interior. A pool of pale yellow liquid surrounds the upper-left edge of the mass, and a bright reflection sits at the lower-right of the plate. Across the excerpt the glossy pink surface and the surrounding yellow pool remain essentially unchanged, with no clearly visible further spread or softening. The stick, the crack pattern, and the plate highlight remain in fixed positions, indicating no object translation and a stationary camera. The configuration is already settled at the first frame, so the clip presents a flattened state with no clearly visible ongoing change rather than a new event.
